details: Existing reporting, EXIF, geofence, review and audit preserved; all 110 original tests still pass
Report is committed before any other agent is called
Optional Idempotency-Key on POST /incidents prevents duplicate reports on retry
Additive schema only: 6 new tables, no existing table or column changed
Agent called over HTTP (POST /api/v1/incidents) with a stable X-Request-ID per incident
Output stored separately in incident_intelligence; citizen category and text never overwritten
Severity maps to dispatch priority HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, otherwise NORMAL
NOT_CONFIGURED, UNAVAILABLE, FAILED and CONFLICT outcomes recorded; report still dispatched; supervisor retry endpoint
Verified end to end against the real agent running locally in mock mode (no Gemini key)
dispatch_task ranking reused with three documented minimal changes
Worker data now from GeoSatya worker_profiles and shared locations, not the branch's static in-memory list
Configurable fallback: labelled workload assignment or escalation to supervisor
Supervisor manual assign, reassign (reason required) and retry dispatch; one task per incident guarantees no duplicates
The branch's own HTTP service is not called (static workers near Ujjain go stale 15 min after start)
Approximate only: straight-line distance x 1.4 route factor at observed approach speed or assumed 20 km/h
Shown as a minute range with states WAITING_FOR_LOCATION, AVAILABLE, STALE, ARRIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE
No road-routing provider configured
Assigned worker shares location during ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS via browser watchPosition or labelled simulation
Citizen sees latest location only while live; supervisor also last-known and up to 20 recent points
Points deleted on completion submission or reassignment; updates throttled to 10 s
Arrival estimated within 50 m; never replaces the 15 m server geofence check
Foreground-only: a web page cannot track in the background
Recomputed only on events: assignment, first location, arrival, work start, completion, rework, reassignment, resolution
Work duration = median of at least 3 resolved jobs in the category, else category baseline in categories.json
Actual resolution time and breakdown computed from recorded timestamps only
No rating exists in any inspected branch; minimal proposal in docs/INTEGRATION.md section 8 awaiting a team decision

tests_run: HTTP smoke test against running GeoSatya :8000 and Incident Intelligence agent :8001 (mock mode)
Browser check of citizen, worker and supervisor pages at desktop and 375 px width
passed: 139 pytest tests passed (110 original + 29 in tests/test_integration.py), 1 dependency deprecation warning
Smoke: intelligence COMPLETED with severity HIGH (INJURY rule) -> priority HIGH
Smoke: dispatch ranked the 0.6 km worker over the 1.6 km worker
Smoke: idempotent retry returned the same incident
Smoke: ETA available, arrival detected at 20 m, geofence PASS at 4 m, tracking ended and points purged, ETR replaced by actual resolution time
Browser: no console errors; no horizontal overflow at 375 px
not_run: Real phone GPS and camera (the browser pane blocks them; labelled simulation used)
Gemini mode of the intelligence agent (no API key)
limitations: Browser tracking stops when the page is closed or suspended
ETR baselines are placeholders until history exists

startup_instructions: Intelligence agent (optional): in a checkout of incident-intelligence-agent, set KAVACH_LLM_MODE=mock and run: python -m uvicorn kavach.main:app --app-dir src --port 8001
GeoSatya: cd services/geosatya; set INTELLIGENCE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8001 (optional); run: uvicorn geosatya.main:create_app --factory --reload
Open http://localhost:8000 and pick a demo role; enable Simulate GPS (demo) when there is no GPS
required_services: GeoSatya FastAPI app (also serves the frontend)
